name: settings
description: Asks before a repository, account or mailbox setting changes through an app: a repository made public, a deploy key or webhook added, a CI secret written, branch protection changed, mail forwarded outside, a public share link. Reads are never asked about.

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-visibility-args
smartRules.reason: This makes a repository public. node9 asks before a repository's visibility changes, whatever the request said (Settings shield).

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-deploy-key
smartRules.reason: This adds a key that grants access to a repository or an account. node9 asks before access keys change (Settings shield).

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-webhook
smartRules.reason: This adds or changes a webhook or integration that receives the account's events. node9 asks before integrations change (Settings shield).

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-ci-secret
smartRules.reason: This writes a secret into a repository, organisation or environment. node9 asks before stored secrets change (Settings shield).

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-branch-protection
smartRules.reason: This changes the rules that protect a branch. node9 asks before branch protection changes (Settings shield).

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-mail-forwarding
smartRules.reason: This forwards or delegates a mailbox to another address. node9 asks before mail leaves the account on its own (Settings shield).

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-mail-filter-forward
smartRules.reason: This mail filter forwards messages to another address. node9 asks before mail leaves the account on its own (Settings shield).

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-public-link
smartRules.reason: This shares a file or folder through a link or with people outside. node9 asks before content is shared outside (Settings shield).

smartRules.name: shield:settings:review-org-security
smartRules.reason: This changes an organisation's security settings. node9 asks before security settings change (Settings shield).
